mapper.select: select * from TB_WIFI_MEMBER where id = #{id}
select * from TB_WIFI_MEMBER where tel = #{tel}
mapper.insert: insert into TB_WIFI_MEMBER (tel, status, point_balance, privacy_agree_dt, marketing_agree_yn, regist_dt) values (#{tel}, #{status}, #{pointBalance}, now()null, ifnull(#{marketingAgreeYn}, 'N'), now())
mapper.update: update TB_WIFI_MEMBER set status = 'ACTIVE', privacy_agree_dt = now(), marketing_agree_yn = ifnull(#{marketingAgreeYn}, 'N') where id = #{id} and status = 'PRE'
update TB_WIFI_MEMBER set last_login_dt = now() where id = #{id}
update TB_WIFI_MEMBER set token_version = token_version + 1 where id = #{id}
update TB_WIFI_MEMBER set point_balance = point_balance + #{amount} where id = #{id}
update TB_WIFI_MEMBER set point_balance = point_balance - #{amount} where id = #{id} and point_balance >= #{amount}
update TB_WIFI_MEMBER set status = 'DELETED', tel = null, kakao_id = null, point_balance = 0, token_version = token_version + 1, delete_dt = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select * from TB_WIFI_MEMBER where point_balance > 0 and point_expire_dt is not null and point_expire_dt < now() and status != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: update TB_WIFI_MEMBER set point_balance = 0 where id = #{id}
mapper.select:
select m.*, (select count(*) from TB_WIFI_DEVICE d where d.member_id = m.id) as device_count from TB_WIFI_MEMBER m
order by m.id desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from TB_WIFI_MEMBER m
mapper.insert: insert into TB_WIFI_POINT_LOG (member_id, amount, reason, order_id, admin_id, memo, regist_dt) values (#{memberId}, #{amount}, #{reason}, #{orderId}, #{adminId}, #{memo}, now())
mapper.select: select * from TB_WIFI_POINT_LOG where member_id = #{memberId} order by id desc limit 200
mapper.insert: insert into TB_WIFI_DEVICE (sn, device_type, tuge_status, regist_dt, modify_dt) values (#{sn}, #{deviceType}, #{tugeStatus}, now(), now()) on duplicate key update device_type = ifnull(#{deviceType}, device_type), tuge_status = ifnull(#{tugeStatus}, tuge_status), modify_dt = now()
mapper.update: update TB_WIFI_DEVICE set member_id = #{memberId}, registered_dt = now(), modify_dt = now() where sn = #{sn} and member_id is null
update TB_WIFI_DEVICE set member_id = null, registered_dt = null, modify_dt = now() where member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: select * from TB_WIFI_DEVICE where member_id = #{memberId} order by registered_dt desc
mapper.insert: insert into TB_WIFI_DEVICE_LOG (sn, member_id, action, admin_id, regist_dt) values (#{sn}, #{memberId}, #{action}, #{adminId}, now())

where.if: (d.sn like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.tel like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
select d.*, m.tel as member_tel from TB_WIFI_DEVICE d left join TB_WIFI_MEMBER m on m.id = d.member_id
order by d.modify_dt desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from TB_WIFI_DEVICE d left join TB_WIFI_MEMBER m on m.id = d.member_id
select p.* from TB_WIFI_PRODUCT p where p.product_code = #{productCode}
mapper.insert: insert into TB_WIFI_PRODUCT (product_code, tuge_name, product_type, days, validity_period, data_limited, data_total, data_unit, mcc, device_type, settlement_usd, popup_json, active_type, rule_desc, tuge_modified_dt, tuge_active, cost_changed_yn, sale_yn, regist_dt, modify_dt) values (#{productCode}, #{tugeName}, #{productType}, #{days}, #{validityPeriod}, #{dataLimited}, #{dataTotal}, #{dataUnit}, #{mcc}, #{deviceType}, #{settlementUsd}, #{popupJson}, #{activeType}, #{ruleDesc}, #{tugeModifiedDt}, 'Y', 'N', 'N', now(), now()) on duplicate key update cost_changed_yn = if(settlement_usd is not null and settlement_usd <> values(settlement_usd), 'Y', cost_changed_yn), tuge_name = values(tuge_name), product_type = values(product_type), days = values(days), validity_period = values(validity_period), data_limited = values(data_limited), data_total = values(data_total), data_unit = values(data_unit), mcc = values(mcc), device_type = values(device_type), settlement_usd = values(settlement_usd), popup_json = values(popup_json), active_type = values(active_type), rule_desc = values(rule_desc), tuge_modified_dt = values(tuge_modified_dt), tuge_active = 'Y'

where.if: (p.product_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.tuge_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.display_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and (p.category_id = #{categoryId} or p.category_id in (select c.id from TB_WIFI_CATEGORY c where c.parent_id = #{categoryId}))

mapper.select:
select p.product_code, p.tuge_name, p.product_type, p.days, p.validity_period, p.data_limited, p.data_total, p.data_unit, p.daily_high_speed_mb, p.mcc, p.device_type, p.settlement_usd, p.popup_json, p.active_type, p.tuge_modified_dt, p.tuge_active, p.cost_changed_yn, p.sale_yn, p.category_id, p.min_period, p.max_period, p.display_name, p.thumbnail, p.sort, p.regist_dt, p.modify_dt from TB_WIFI_PRODUCT p
order by p.sale_yn desc, p.sort asc, p.regist_dt desc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select count(*) from TB_WIFI_PRODUCT p
mapper.update: update TB_WIFI_PRODUCT set sale_yn = #{saleYn}, category_id = #{categoryId}, min_period = #{minPeriod}, max_period = #{maxPeriod}, display_name = #{displayName}, thumbnail = #{thumbnail}, detail_html = #{detailHtml}, daily_high_speed_mb = #{dailyHighSpeedMb}, sort = #{sort}, cost_changed_yn = 'N', modify_dt = now() where product_code = #{productCode}
mapper.sql: p.sale_yn = 'Y' and p.tuge_active = 'Y' and p.category_id is not null and p.settlement_usd is not null and (p.device_type is null or p.device_type = '' or find_in_set(#{deviceType}, replace(p.device_type, ' ', '')) > 0)
mapper.select: select p.product_code, p.product_type, p.days, p.validity_period, p.data_limited, p.data_total, p.data_unit, p.daily_high_speed_mb, p.display_name, p.tuge_name, p.thumbnail, p.sort, p.settlement_usd, p.category_id, p.min_period, p.max_period from TB_WIFI_PRODUCT p where and p.category_id = #{categoryId} order by p.sort asc, p.display_name asc
select c.*, (select count(*) from TB_WIFI_PRODUCT p where p.category_id = c.id) as product_count from TB_WIFI_CATEGORY c order by c.sort asc, c.id asc

select c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.image, c.sort from TB_WIFI_CATEGORY c where c.use_yn = 'Y' and (exists (select 1 from TB_WIFI_PRODUCT p where p.category_id = c.id and ) or exists (select 1 from TB_WIFI_CATEGORY ch join TB_WIFI_PRODUCT p on p.category_id = ch.id where ch.parent_id = c.id and ch.use_yn = 'Y' and )) order by c.sort asc, c.id asc
mapper.insert: insert into TB_WIFI_CATEGORY (parent_id, name, image, sort, use_yn, usd_rate, margin_rate, period_rules, regist_dt) values (#{parentId}, #{name}, #{image}, #{sort}, ifnull(#{useYn}, 'Y'), #{usdRate}, #{marginRate}, #{periodRules}, now())
mapper.select: select count(*) from TB_WIFI_CATEGORY where parent_id = #{id}
select * from TB_WIFI_CATEGORY where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update TB_WIFI_PRODUCT set category_id = null, sale_yn = 'N' where category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.insert: insert into TB_WIFI_ORDER (order_no, member_id, device_sn, product_code, option_id, product_name, order_period, total_krw, point_used, pay_krw, settlement_usd, payment_status, topup_status, regist_dt, modify_dt) values (#{orderNo}, #{memberId}, #{deviceSn}, #{productCode}, #{optionId}, #{productName}, #{orderPeriod}, #{totalKrw}, #{pointUsed}, #{payKrw}, #{settlementUsd}, #{paymentStatus}, 'READY', now(), now())
mapper.select: select * from TB_WIFI_ORDER where order_no = #{orderNo}
select * from TB_WIFI_ORDER where id = #{id}
mapper.update: update TB_WIFI_ORDER set payment_status = #{to}, pg_transaction_id = #{pgTransactionId}, modify_dt = now() where id = #{id} and payment_status = #{from}

update TB_WIFI_ORDER set topup_status = #{topupStatus}, tuge_order_no = #{tugeOrderNo}, tuge_flow_order_nos = #{tugeFlowOrderNos}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, last_error = #{lastError}, modify_dt = now() where id = #{id}
update TB_WIFI_ORDER set earn_point = #{earnPoint}, modify_dt = now() where id = #{id} and earn_point = 0
mapper.select: select * from TB_WIFI_ORDER where topup_status = 'RETRY' and payment_status in ('PAID', 'POINT_ONLY') and modify_dt < date_sub(now(), interval 50 second) order by id asc limit 50

select id, order_no, device_sn, product_code, product_name, order_period, total_krw, point_used, pay_krw, earn_point, payment_status, topup_status, refund_status, refund_krw, refund_point, regist_dt from TB_WIFI_ORDER where member_id = #{memberId} and payment_status != 'PAY_READY' order by id desc limit 100
mapper.update: update TB_WIFI_ORDER set refund_status = 'REQUESTED', refund_reason = #{reason}, refund_request_dt = now(), modify_dt = now() where id = #{id} and member_id = #{memberId} and refund_status is null and topup_status = 'DONE' and payment_status in ('PAID', 'POINT_ONLY')

update TB_WIFI_ORDER set payment_status = #{to}, refund_status = 'DONE', refund_krw = #{refundKrw}, refund_point = #{refundPoint}, refund_memo = left(concat_ws(' / ', refund_memo, #{memo}), 500), refund_dt = now(), modify_dt = now() where id = #{id} and payment_status = #{from} and refund_krw = #{prevKrw} and refund_point = #{prevPoint}
update TB_WIFI_ORDER set refund_status = 'REJECTED', refund_memo = #{memo}, refund_dt = now(), modify_dt = now() where id = #{id} and refund_status = 'REQUESTED'
